name: Etoile no Houteishiki
source:
Main character has a weak boy, so today is the first time when he attends the Etoile private school famous for its arts taught at the entertainment department. As a freshman he gets attached to sempai who manages his daily lesson schedule. His sempai is organizing the "Gold Rush" talent tournament. Is it possible to win it?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公自幼体弱多病，今天是他第一天踏入以演艺科艺术教学闻名的“私立艾托瓦尔学园”。身为一年级新生的他，被安排由一位学长贴身负责打理每日的课程日程。眼下这位学长正忙着筹办名为“淘金热”的才艺选秀大赛——他们究竟能否一举夺魁？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
